g.text: Multi-Region Hub-and-Spoke Web App with Centralized SIEM
Every web VPC ships logs privately over Transit Gateway to one Loki/Grafana server. Operators reach it with SSM only (no SSH).
Six spoke regions (one Terraform module call each)
One route table, every route explicit
Log store and database stay in Tokyo
but cannot query them or reach the DB.
Solid arrows: data path. Dashed arrow: operator access. Colours: blue = spoke regions, green = hub, purple = Transit Gateway, red = security zone.
